title: The Renewal of the Covenant between God and Israel
description: At the conclusion of Moses' speech on the plains of Moab, the Lord and Israel enter into a mutual covenant: The people declare that the Lord shall be their God, and they commit themselves to walk in his ways and keep his statutes, commandments, and judgments. For his part, the Lord declares that Israel shall be his treasured possession, set high above all nations for praise, honor, and glory, and be a holy people to him.
